title: Arcángel Unveils La 8va Maravilla World Tour 20 Aniversario Dates
summary: The first leg of the trek will make pit stops in Europe and Latin America, with more dates and cities to be announced.
contentText:
Arcángel has announced the first leg of his 2026 La 8va Maravilla World Tour 20 Aniversario, Billboard can exclusively announce today (March 2).

The Puerto Rican artist—who’s hitting the road in support of his eight studio album, but also in celebration of his 20th career anniversary—will first visit fans across Europe and Latin America, kicking off May 13 in Spain. He will then navigate to Ecuador, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, and more countries, before culminating in Costa Rica on Sept. 26. Additional cities and dates will be announced soon.

“I didn’t tour with my last album,” Arcángel previously said during the Billboard Español digital cover story interview. “This one’s going to be really extensive because I plan to include all the material from my career, and you’ll see the different stages…the Arcángel from 2005, 2009, 2019. Thank God I have songs to sing for five to six hours or even more.”

La 8va Maravilla World Tour comes on the heels of the “La Jumpa” singer receiving the Urban Icon Award at the 2026 Premio Lo Nuestro, where he was celebrated with a powerful medley of his hits featuring Jhayco, J Balvin, Jay Wheeler, Mora, Sech, and Eladio Carrión.

It also follows the coveted Billboard Español cover story that was published in January, where Arcángel got candid about his open-heart surgery that lead to creating his first sober album, La 8va Maravilla —a set that includes collaborations with Ricky Martin, Daddy Yankee, and Grupo Firme, to name a few.

Tickets for La 8va Maravilla World Tour 20 Aniversario go on sale at 10 AM local time on Thursday, March 5th on www.la8vamaravilla.com .
